The '''Calrissian-Nunb Mines''' were a highly profitable [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] company located on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] and owned by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]; his wife, [[Tendra Risant Calrissian|Tendra Calrissian]]; and [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Nien Nunb/Legends|Nien Nunb]]. They were founded by Lando in approximately [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]] when he owned the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines of Kessel]].<ref name="Outcast" />
